nodes.name: Consensus network topology
nodes.question: How are nodes arranged and which nodes participate in maintaining consensus?

nodes.name: Block-adding access restriction
nodes.question: Who is permitted to add blocks to the ledger?

nodes.name: Ledger read, write and consensus governance model
nodes.question: Who has read access, write access, and the right to manage consensus on the ledger?

nodes.name: Consensus mechanism
nodes.question: What rule is used to agree which transactions are recorded and validated?

nodes.name: Consensus fault tolerance threshold
nodes.question: What proportion of corrupted or malicious participants can the consensus tolerate before failing?

nodes.name: Network energy intensity
nodes.question: How energy-intensive is the network's consensus process?

nodes.name: Transaction finality type
nodes.question: Is transaction finality reached with certainty at a fixed point or only probabilistically?

nodes.name: Network message propagation scope
nodes.question: Is consensus reached locally before propagation, or are messages gossiped globally to random peers?

nodes.name: Message delivery timing model
nodes.question: Are message delays bounded, or can they be unbounded?

nodes.name: Immutability and governance basis
nodes.question: How is ledger immutability maintained, and by whom can it be altered?

nodes.name: Fork type
nodes.question: Is the ledger change a backward-compatible or incompatible fork?

nodes.name: Layout effect on performance
nodes.question: How does the count of a given element class affect global system behaviour?

nodes.name: Scaling binding constraint
nodes.question: Which resource (transactions, users or account states, nodes, or traffic) limits the system's scalability?

nodes.name: Node data storage model
nodes.question: Do nodes hold full equivalent copies of the data, or only a subset of it?

nodes.name: Block storage content
nodes.question: Does the ledger store transactions or the resulting user balances?

nodes.name: Transaction fee model
nodes.question: Is the transaction fee variable with transaction size or fixed by request type?

nodes.name: Native currency status
nodes.question: Does the system have its own native asset, and if so how many?

nodes.name: Tokenisation provision
nodes.question: How is tokenisation provided by the system?

nodes.name: Tokenisation platform blockchain environment
nodes.question: Does the tokenisation platform run on a private permissioned blockchain or a permissioned system atop a public permissionless chain?

nodes.name: Privacy-enhancing technique
nodes.question: Which technique is used to obscure transaction parties or links on a public blockchain?

nodes.name: Data encryption and validation method
nodes.question: How is ledger data secured and validated cryptographically without disclosing underlying inputs?

nodes.name: Codebase coding language
nodes.question: Is the system implemented in one programming language or several?

nodes.name: Scripting language expressiveness
nodes.question: How computationally general is the scripting language, and can it access data outside the blockchain?

nodes.name: Protocol governance model
nodes.question: Who sets the technical rules of the system: an open community, a single firm, or an industry alliance?

nodes.name: Code license openness
nodes.question: Is the source code publicly available and open?

nodes.name: Software architecture
nodes.question: Is the codebase built as a single unit or as separable components?

nodes.name: Automation mechanism
nodes.question: Are transaction rules enforced automatically by self-executing code?

nodes.name: Data storage location
nodes.question: Where is the data associated with a transaction stored?

nodes.name: Distributed ledger definitional basis
nodes.question: Does the technology qualify as a distributed ledger, and is it a blockchain?

nodes.name: Blockchain definition criteria met
nodes.question: Does the system satisfy all statutory blockchain criteria: shared, cryptographically linked, automatically distributed public ledger with public source code?

nodes.name: Distributed ledger component type
nodes.question: Is the distributed ledger component a protocol, application, or whole system?

nodes.name: Network layer position
nodes.question: Is the network a base blockchain or a secondary network built on top of one?

nodes.name: DeFi technology stack layer
nodes.question: Which layer of the DeFi stack does a component belong to, and what function does it perform?

nodes.name: Network decentralisation status
nodes.question: Is the network sufficiently decentralised that no person or group controls its governance?

nodes.name: Decentralisation test outcome
nodes.question: Can any person unilaterally alter rules, and do holdings, voting power or source-code changes exceed control thresholds over the test period?

nodes.name: Decentralised finance trading protocol status
nodes.question: Is the system a decentralised finance trading protocol operating on predetermined, non-discretionary rules without intermediaries or common control?

nodes.name: Decentralised finance messaging system status
nodes.question: Is the software a messaging system that lets users submit instructions to a protocol without third-party control over funds or execution?

nodes.name: Wallet signing arrangement
nodes.question: Is a wallet single-signature or multiple-signature, and how is signing authority split among keys?

nodes.name: Wallet connectivity
nodes.question: Is the wallet connected to the internet, trading security against speed?

nodes.name: DLT access permission basis
nodes.question: Can any party participate without approval, or does participation require approval by an authority?

nodes.name: Quantum threat exposure
nodes.question: Does the system rely on public-key cryptography exposed to quantum attack, and can it migrate to standardised post-quantum algorithms?

nodes.name: Cryptographic agility
nodes.question: Can the platform replace cryptographic algorithms without disrupting operations?

nodes.name: Node role
nodes.question: Does the node validate transactions, record data, or commit blocks?

nodes.name: Asset definitional basis
nodes.question: Is the asset defined by its underlying technology or by its use case?

nodes.name: Fungibility
nodes.question: Is the asset interchangeable unit for unit with others of its kind?

nodes.name: Asset technical standard
nodes.question: Is the token native to its chain or a smart-contract standard token, and is it fungible or non-fungible?

nodes.name: Virtual asset status
nodes.question: Does the digital representation of value fall within the virtual asset definition, or is it another financial asset?

nodes.name: Qualifying cryptoasset scope
nodes.question: Is the cryptoasset fungible and transferable, and not solely a record of value or contractual rights?

nodes.name: Legal tender status
nodes.question: Does the asset have legal tender status?

nodes.name: Convertibility and currency substitution
nodes.question: Does the asset have equivalent value to currency or substitute for it?

nodes.name: Value substitute for currency
nodes.question: Is the value a substitute for currency, whether created for that use or repurposed by an administrator?

nodes.name: Minting mechanism
nodes.question: How does the crypto-asset originate?

nodes.name: Issuer presence
nodes.question: Is there a single identifiable issuer, a protocol issuer, or no issuer?

nodes.name: Yield type
nodes.question: Does the asset return capital appreciation, yield, or neither?

nodes.name: Yield distribution mechanism
nodes.question: How is yield delivered to holders: by increasing quantity, value, or price, or by external redistribution?

nodes.name: Control model
nodes.question: Who controls governance, issuance, yield, and redemption?

nodes.name: Economic function
nodes.question: What economic role does the token play for its holders?

nodes.name: Holder rights form
nodes.question: Are holder rights contractual or property-type, and is the claim against the issuer's balance sheet or a segregated reserve?

nodes.name: Redemption mechanism
nodes.question: How and by whom can holders redeem or exit the asset for its underlying value?

nodes.name: Redemption reference asset type
nodes.question: What does the asset's redemption right or value reference: fiat, physical or collateral assets, other tokens, or nothing?

nodes.name: Redemption legal character
nodes.question: Does redemption create a legal claim, a regulatory obligation, or only market exposure?

nodes.name: Securities classification
nodes.question: Is the asset a security or financial instrument under the applicable test?

nodes.name: Digital asset security category
nodes.question: Does the digital asset fall within a listed security, security derivative, or other instrument category?

nodes.name: Digital asset ownership and creditor rights
nodes.question: Does the asset give holders an ownership, creditor, interest or income right in an enterprise?

nodes.name: Digital commodity status
nodes.question: Is the asset a digital commodity under the applicable framework?

nodes.name: Digital commodity value source
nodes.question: Is the asset's value derived from the programmatic functioning of its network or from others' managerial efforts?

nodes.name: Intrinsic blockchain linkage
nodes.question: Is the digital asset intrinsically linked to a blockchain system, with functional uses such as fees, governance or incentives within it?

nodes.name: Legal asset category
nodes.question: Which legal category does the asset fall into among securities, stablecoins, funds, and other crypto-assets?

nodes.name: Stable value purpose
nodes.question: Is the asset designed to maintain a stable value against a reference?

nodes.name: Reference asset type
nodes.question: What does the asset's value reference or track?

nodes.name: Reserve backing type
nodes.question: What reserves back the stable-value token?

nodes.name: Stablecoin classification conditions
nodes.question: Do the redemption rights, reserves and network design meet the conditions for a stabilised stablecoin?

nodes.name: Stablecoin redemption and reserve test
nodes.question: Do reserves cover the peg value and consist of low-risk, liquid assets with enforceable redemption?

nodes.name: Stablecoin issuer prudential supervision
nodes.question: Is the stablecoin issuer supervised under prudential capital and liquidity rules?

nodes.name: Stablecoin freeze capability
nodes.question: Can the issuer freeze, block or burn stablecoin units under lawful orders?

nodes.name: Permitted payment stablecoin status
nodes.question: Does the stablecoin meet the permitted payment stablecoin criteria for payment use, redemption, and issuer regulation?

nodes.name: Permitted payment stablecoin issuer category
nodes.question: Is the issuer an insured depository institution subsidiary, a federal qualified issuer, or a state qualified issuer?

nodes.name: Stablecoin arrangement function status
nodes.question: Does the party redeem, transfer, store or settle the stablecoin, and is it regulated?

nodes.name: Stablecoin arrangement participant role
nodes.question: Is the party a validator, cloud host, hardware maker, merchant, or software developer without VASP functions?

nodes.name: Restricted digital asset status
nodes.question: Is the digital asset restricted by holder status, acquisition channel, and blockchain decentralisation?

nodes.name: Network maturity status
nodes.question: Has the network reached mature decentralised governance such that the asset is no longer subject to issuer-based treatment?

nodes.name: Digital asset issuance or distribution activity
nodes.question: Is the asset issued or distributed through an ICO, pre-sale, airdrop, or end-user distribution?

nodes.name: Mature system end user distribution status
nodes.question: Were all units issued through programmatic functioning as end user distributions, and was the asset marketed to the public as an investment?

nodes.name: Securities registration status
nodes.question: Must the digital asset offering be registered under the Securities Act or exempt?

nodes.name: Regulated crypto-asset issuance or service perimeter
nodes.question: Is the offering, admission or service performed for others by a regulated entity within the framework's perimeter?

nodes.name: Tokenised asset status
nodes.question: Does the tokenised asset carry the same risks and legal rights as its traditional form?

nodes.name: Tokenised asset type
nodes.question: Is the tokenised asset a financial asset or a non-financial one?

nodes.name: Ledger record type
nodes.question: Is the asset recorded on a public, cryptographically secured ledger accessible without an intermediary?

nodes.name: Asset classification in fund and securities context
nodes.question: Is the blockchain-based asset classed as a security, fund unit or other financial asset under the applicable test?

nodes.name: Funds or assets category
nodes.question: Does the item fall within the broad definition of funds or other assets?

nodes.name: High-value goods status
nodes.question: Is the good a high-value good, precious metal or stone, or cultural good?

nodes.name: Legal entity identification status
nodes.question: Does the party have a standard legal entity identifier conforming to ISO 17442?

nodes.name: Transfer party role
nodes.question: What role does a party play in a crypto-asset transfer?

nodes.name: Originator account type
nodes.question: Does the originator hold a crypto-asset account, distributed ledger address, or storage device?

nodes.name: VASP-covered business activity
nodes.question: Which listed service does the business perform for others?

nodes.name: Exchange and trading service model
nodes.question: How does the trading or exchange service operate?

nodes.name: Trading platform possession
nodes.question: Does the platform take possession of the convertible virtual currency between buyers and sellers?

nodes.name: Custody and control capability
nodes.question: Can the entity hold, trade, transfer or spend a virtual asset, or enable control through keys or contracts?

nodes.name: Custody arrangement
nodes.question: Who holds the keys or controls the asset: a custodian or the user?

nodes.name: Custody provider type
nodes.question: Is the custodian a regulated institution or an unregulated custody provider?

nodes.name: Wallet custodial control
nodes.question: Can the wallet provider unilaterally move client assets?

nodes.name: Cryptoasset safeguarding control
nodes.question: Does the party hold or store means of access, or appoint a custodian to do so?

nodes.name: Peer-to-peer platform function
nodes.question: Does the peer-to-peer platform merely provide a forum or perform matching or finding services?

nodes.name: Operator control and profit
nodes.question: Who profits, sets rules, controls operations, or could shut down the service?

nodes.name: Software developer VASP status
nodes.question: Does the developer or platform creator retain control or influence over assets or user relationships?

nodes.name: Ancillary provider status
nodes.question: Does the provider facilitate covered activities for others, or only supply hardware, software or network infrastructure?

nodes.name: Digital asset infrastructure function
nodes.question: What infrastructure function does the provider perform?

nodes.name: ICO participation type
nodes.question: How is the business involved in the initial coin offering?

nodes.name: Token sale business model
nodes.question: Is the token sale a preferential group sale or an equity or debt token fundraise?

nodes.name: Trading venue type
nodes.question: Is the digital asset trade executed on a centralised or decentralised venue?

nodes.name: Trading product type
nodes.question: Is the trade spot, futures, perpetual, or an option?

nodes.name: Order type
nodes.question: Is the order executed at market price, at a limit, or triggered by a stop?

nodes.name: Staking participation model
nodes.question: Does the holder operate a validator, use a service, use liquid staking, or delegate via contract?

nodes.name: Staking control retention
nodes.question: Does the holder retain control of tokens during staking?

nodes.name: Staking service status
nodes.question: Is the cryptoasset used in blockchain validation through a staking arrangement that is a regulated activity?

nodes.name: Slashing exposure
nodes.question: Are validators penalised for misbehaviour through loss of staked tokens?

nodes.name: Transaction sequencing and MEV exposure
nodes.question: Is the transaction exposed to maximal extractable value through sequencing?

nodes.name: Crypto-asset service scope
nodes.question: Does the service fall within the crypto-asset services category or is it excluded (such as advice)?

nodes.name: Incidental activity exclusion
nodes.question: Is the crypto activity merely incidental to a profession, with no systematic income and under professional supervision?

nodes.name: Stablecoin issuance activity
nodes.question: Is the party offering, creating within a group, or redeeming and holding reserves for a qualifying stablecoin?

nodes.name: Cryptoasset trading activity
nodes.question: Is the party operating a trading platform or dealing as principal in cryptoassets?

nodes.name: Cryptoasset dealing mode
nodes.question: Does the party deal in cryptoassets as principal or as agent, or arrange deals for others?

nodes.name: Digital commodity intermediary role
nodes.question: Does the person act as a broker, dealer, exchange, or custodian of digital commodities?

nodes.name: Associated person of a digital commodity intermediary
nodes.question: Is the person an associated person of a digital commodity broker or dealer through solicitation, order acceptance or supervisory roles, excluding purely clerical functions?

nodes.name: Mixed digital asset transaction
nodes.question: Does the trade exchange a digital commodity for a security?

nodes.name: Digital commodity dealer market role
nodes.question: Does the person hold itself out as a dealer or market maker, or is it a registered or excluded counterparty?

nodes.name: Affiliation with a digital commodity issuer
nodes.question: Does the person have control, common control, or a 5% or greater holding relationship with the issuer or asset?

nodes.name: Digital asset service provider status
nodes.question: Does the person perform listed exchange, transfer, custody or issuance services for compensation in U.S. business, excluding protocol developers and validators?

nodes.name: Travel Rule transfer type
nodes.question: Is the transaction a transmittal of funds subject to the Travel Rule, and what is its value?

nodes.name: Transfer channel type
nodes.question: Is the transfer a credit transfer, direct debit, remittance, card or device-based transfer, or person-to-person transfer?

nodes.name: Business relationship type
nodes.question: Is the relationship a professional connection with expected repetition or duration, or a linked set of transactions?

nodes.name: Illicit actor type
nodes.question: Which kind of criminal or state-linked actor uses virtual assets for illicit activity?

nodes.name: Intermediary role in illicit schemes
nodes.question: What role does an intermediary play in an illicit virtual asset scheme, serving one criminal network or several?

nodes.name: Illicit laundering technique
nodes.question: Which method is used to obscure or move illicit virtual asset proceeds?

nodes.name: Reason for illicit virtual asset use
nodes.question: Why do criminals prefer virtual assets for the illicit activity?

nodes.name: Fraud and scam scheme type
nodes.question: What kind of fraud or scam is being perpetrated with virtual assets?

nodes.name: AML and sanctions-evasion risk factor
nodes.question: Does the feature amplify money laundering, terrorist financing, or sanctions-evasion risk?

nodes.name: Linked financial crime threat
nodes.question: Which related financial crime threat is linked to the illicit virtual asset activity?

nodes.name: Offshore VASP home regime strength
nodes.question: Is the offshore VASP's home regulatory framework strong or weak, and is it licensed by host jurisdictions?

nodes.name: Offshore active service to jurisdiction
nodes.question: Does the offshore entity actively serve customers in a jurisdiction, or maintain material local substance?

nodes.name: VASP licensing or registration status
nodes.question: Where is the VASP incorporated or licensed, and is it already a licensed financial institution?

nodes.name: VASP exemption from separate treatment
nodes.question: Is the entity already an existing financial institution exempt from separate VASP treatment?

nodes.name: Money transmitter status
nodes.question: Does the person accept and transmit value for others, or perform a non-transmitter function?

nodes.name: Anonymising service type
nodes.question: Does the provider offer anonymising services such as mixing, or only supply anonymising software?

nodes.name: Integral activity exemption status
nodes.question: Is the business distinct from money transmission, or is transmission necessary to its operation so the exemption fails?

nodes.name: Mining activity status
nodes.question: Does the miner use mined CVC only for itself, or transmit value for others?

nodes.name: Payment processor exemption status
nodes.question: Does the CVC payment processor meet the exemption conditions?

nodes.name: Anonymity-enhanced provider type
nodes.question: Is the anonymity-enhanced CVC provider centralised or decentralised, and does it receive or transmit value?

nodes.name: Hosted wallet provider role
nodes.question: Is the hosted wallet owner a user, an agent of the host, or a financial institution?

nodes.name: Supervisory authority type
nodes.question: Is the supervisor a competent authority or a self-regulatory body?

nodes.name: Federal regulator mandate
nodes.question: Which market or institution type does the regulator supervise?

nodes.name: Regulatory scope entity category
nodes.question: Which category of entity falls within the regulation's scope?

nodes.name: DORA financial entity category
nodes.question: Under which regulated financial entity category is the entity authorised?

nodes.name: Enterprise size class
nodes.question: Is the enterprise a microenterprise, small enterprise, or medium-sized enterprise by staff and turnover or balance-sheet thresholds?

nodes.name: Small occupational pension institution status
nodes.question: Does the occupational pension institution have fewer than 100 members?

nodes.name: Critical ICT third-party provider status
nodes.question: Has the ICT third-party provider been designated as critical?

nodes.name: ICT provider establishment location
nodes.question: Where is the ICT third-party provider legally established?

nodes.name: ICT provider group relationship
nodes.question: Is the ICT provider within the same group as the financial entity?

nodes.name: Critical or important function status
nodes.question: Would disruption to the function materially impair performance, continuity or compliance?

nodes.name: ICT incident severity
nodes.question: Does the ICT-related incident have an adverse impact on critical functions or payment services?

nodes.name: ICT incident type
nodes.question: Is the incident ICT-related or payment-related?

nodes.name: Cyber threat significance
nodes.question: Is the cyber threat significant or ordinary?

nodes.name: Legacy ICT system status
nodes.question: Is the ICT system end-of-life, unsupported, or still in use?

nodes.name: Operational risk category
nodes.question: Which operational risk category does the event or weakness fall into?

nodes.name: Prominent public function status
nodes.question: Does the person hold a prominent public function such as a politically exposed person role?

nodes.name: Shell institution status
nodes.question: Does the institution have physical presence, management, or regulatory affiliation in a jurisdiction?

nodes.name: Trust arrangement category
nodes.question: Is the trust an express trust, an object of a power, a default taker, or another legal arrangement?

nodes.name: Sanctions legal source
nodes.question: What is the legal source of the targeted financial sanctions, UN or EU?

nodes.name: Applicable rule tradition
nodes.question: Under which regulatory tradition is the asset or activity classified?

nodes.name: Home jurisdiction for regulated actor
nodes.question: Which Member State or jurisdiction serves as the home regulator for the actor, based on registered office, branch, or authorisation?
